text: Appeal of Order to Comply (December 9, 2021) for 451 Queen Street East.

The Property Standards Committee, Toronto and East York Panel: 1. Rescinded Item 1 in the Order to Comply (December 9, 2021) for 451 Queen Street East, Folder Number: 21 246515 PRS 00 IV. 2. Confirmed Item 2 in the Order to Comply (December 9, 2021) for 451 Queen Street East, Folder Number: 21 246515 PRS 00 IV. 3. Rescinded Item 3 in the Order to Comply (December 9, 2021) for 451 Queen Street East, Folder Number: 21 246515 PRS 00 IV, as the Section of the By-law referred in the Order to Comply does not relate to the alleged deficiency. In the alternative, if the Panel is incorrect, the Panel would find Item 3 in the Order to Comply to have been complied with.
